quick.summary: How to stop surprise delays by finding out who holds the keys early.
quick.takeaway: Find the people who can block your work before you start planning.

beats.line: I built what the directors asked for. Why did legal block it today?
They hold the keys, even if they skip meetings.
Think of a restaurant. The chef cooks. The health inspector closes it.
The inspector does not cook, but they can ruin my day.
Right. You must find them early. We call this a power interest grid.
Can I just say who can stop me?
That works perfectly. Find who can stop you.
Ask your visible directors who else has to sign off. List them early.
So I find the hidden blockers before I start writing the plan.
And then you keep them updated.

quiz.question: Which person is a hidden stakeholder you need to manage?
options: The compliance officer who only reviews finished products.
The engineer writing the code every day.
The customer buying the final product.
quiz.explanation: They do not do the daily work, but they have the power to stop the launch.

quiz.question: You only need to manage the stakeholders who attend your weekly meetings.
quiz.explanation: People with the power to block you often skip daily or weekly meetings. You have to find them.
